title: Restore service startup after versioned migration wiring defect
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: На бою теперь вообще не стартует, сразу вылетает. Локально запустил - там вот такая картина

scope.goal: Correct the confirmed versioned-migration dependency-injection startup defect, keep immutable baseline 0001 unchanged, move the exact pending signals trader-wallet index out of baseline SQL into ordered migration 0002, and ensure fatal startup failures return a nonzero process exit.
inScope: Ensure production dependency-injection construction of PostgresSchemaInitializer uses PostgresSchemaMigrationCatalog.CreateDefault() and cannot select the test-only custom-catalog constructor with an empty unregistered IEnumerable<PostgresSchemaMigration>.

Add a focused regression test that resolves IStorageSchemaInitializer through the same implementation-type DI registration shape used by the service and proves construction succeeds without registering individual PostgresSchemaMigration services.

Restore the exact uncommitted ix_signals_trader_wallet_id definition out of immutable PostgresSchema.SchemaSql baseline 0001 while preserving its approved non-unique unfiltered B-tree shape on signals(trader_wallet, id).

Add ordered non-transactional migration 0002 for CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS public.ix_signals_trader_wallet_id on public.signals(trader_wallet, id), with an exact PostgreSQL catalog completion check that accepts only the requested valid, ready, live index shape before recording success.

On the first deployment start, after exact existing-production baseline eligibility succeeds, create or verify migration 0002 outside an explicit transaction, record it only after its completion check succeeds, and then continue to the ordinary service host.

Adapt the existing uncommitted focused index assertion so it verifies migration 0002 rather than modifying immutable baseline SQL, and extend migration tests for first application, second-start skip, and conflicting same-name shape rejection.
Make the existing top-level fatal startup exception path set a nonzero process exit code after logging the exception.
Run focused tests, a complete solution build, an isolated local fatal-start process smoke test, requirement validation, and independent semantic review.

Bring the exact two previously uncommitted ix_signals_trader_wallet_id source/test edits into this revised contract only through the migration-0002 representation; preserve every other pre-existing unrelated working-tree change outside this contract's commits.
outOfScope: Changing immutable baseline 0001 identifier, checksum, SQL, existing-production eligibility predicates, or successful pending-only migration semantics.
Connecting a local service run to production, changing production PostgreSQL, deploying or starting/stopping/restarting the production service, or changing server files or configuration.
Changing strategies, signals, bets, orders, Paper/Live execution, stakes, PnL, Dashboard behavior, runtime workers, or external API behavior.

Directly creating, dropping, rebuilding, reindexing, or mutating ix_signals_trader_wallet_id in production during this local implementation task; production creation occurs only later when the user deploys and starts the approved build.

Adding a migration framework, redesigning dependency injection generally, refactoring unrelated startup code, or absorbing any working-tree edit other than the exact ix_signals_trader_wallet_id definition and its paired focused assertion.
scope.periodOrFilter: Ordinary PolyCopyTrader.Service startup for immutable baseline 0001 and exact pending migration 0002 only; index scope is all rows of public.signals with keys (trader_wallet, id), without predicate, uniqueness, or included columns.
scope.firstVerification: Run a fresh bounded read-only production preview for exact endpoint, baseline-history absence, public.signals identity and size, exact same-name index state, service heartbeat/sessions, and locks; separately resolve IStorageSchemaInitializer from an isolated ServiceCollection with a dummy non-production factory without opening any database connection.

requirements.text: Ordinary service dependency injection must construct PostgresSchemaInitializer with the non-empty default migration catalog.
acceptanceCriteria: The custom-catalog constructor remains available to the existing friend test assembly but is not a public constructor candidate for the production DI container.
The public production constructor continues to call PostgresSchemaMigrationCatalog.CreateDefault().
Resolving IStorageSchemaInitializer from a ServiceCollection with the production implementation-type registration succeeds when no PostgresSchemaMigration service is registered.
The DI regression test performs no database connection, schema operation, or external call.

verification.command: Run the focused PostgresSchemaMigrationTests under the marked D:\CodexTemp run.
verification.expected: The new production-DI construction regression passes together with baseline-0001 checksum, migration-0002 shape/application/no-replay/conflict, and existing isolated PostgreSQL migration tests.

requirements.text: The exact permanent signals trader-wallet index must be represented and applied as ordered migration 0002 rather than as a mutation of immutable baseline 0001.
acceptanceCriteria: PostgresSchema.SchemaSql again has the exact approved baseline-0001 semantic checksum 4dba8fe092057778ff146e61be43cabbb882358c679c8ee70ade832a872b00d2 and contains no ix_signals_trader_wallet_id definition.

PostgresSchemaMigrationCatalog.CreateDefault() returns baseline 0001 first and exactly one later migration 0002 with a stable identifier, deterministic order, non-transactional mode, and CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS for public.signals(trader_wallet, id).

Migration 0002 completion SQL requires one exact public B-tree index named ix_signals_trader_wallet_id that is valid, ready, live, non-unique, has exactly trader_wallet then id as key attributes, and has no predicate, expressions, or included columns.

On an empty isolated database, baseline 0001 completes before migration 0002, both history rows are recorded only after success, and a second initialization executes neither baseline nor index DDL again.

An existing exact index is accepted and recorded without recreation; a conflicting same-name definition does not satisfy completion and initialization fails without recording migration 0002 or dropping/replacing the object.
The paired StorageTests assertion verifies migration 0002 and immutable-baseline exclusion instead of requiring the index inside PostgresSchema.SchemaSql.

verification.command: Run focused migration-catalog/index-shape tests and isolated PostgreSQL migration integration tests under the marked D:\CodexTemp run.
verification.expected: Tests prove unchanged baseline checksum, exact migration-0002 definition/completion predicate, empty-bootstrap application, existing-index adoption, conflict rejection, success-only history, and second-start no replay.

verification.command: Run bounded UTC REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY queries against exact 192.168.0.101:5432/polycopytrader before implementation for migration history, public.signals identity/size, exact same-name index state, heartbeat/sessions, and locks.
verification.expected: The preview reports exact cutoff, endpoint, counts and risk state without changing production; any unexpected existing/conflicting index or database state stops implementation for a new decision.

requirements.text: A fatal exception during ordinary service startup must result in a nonzero process exit code.
requirements.sourceQuote: Локально запустил - там вот такая картина
acceptanceCriteria: The existing top-level catch continues to write the Fatal Serilog event and additionally sets Environment.ExitCode to 1.
A bounded local process smoke test against an intentionally unreachable loopback PostgreSQL endpoint exits with code 1 and does not contact production.
Successful ordinary host shutdown semantics are otherwise unchanged.

verification.command: Launch the freshly built service executable from a marked D:\CodexTemp output with POLYCOPYTRADER_POSTGRES_CONNECTION overridden to an unreachable 127.0.0.1 endpoint and a bounded connection timeout; capture only its exit code and sanitized startup log.
verification.expected: The process exits within the bound with code 1 after a fatal startup log and makes no production connection.

requirements.text: The repair must remain limited to the confirmed startup defects and the exact approved migration-0002 index move and must not alter trading behavior or directly mutate production.
acceptanceCriteria: Baseline 0001 identifier/checksum/SQL, production eligibility predicates, and existing migration-history safety behavior remain unchanged; only exact migration 0002 is added.
No production database, service, deployment, configuration, strategy, signal, bet, order, Paper/Live, PnL, Dashboard, or API state changes during implementation or verification.
The complete solution builds with zero errors and focused tests pass.
Pre-existing unrelated working-tree changes remain outside this contract's commits and are byte-for-diff preserved.
Independent review compares both verbatim user requests, the approved contract, the actual diff, and verification evidence and returns PASS with no open findings.

verification.expected: The complete solution builds with zero errors.

verification.expected: Only approved paths and context/contract records changed; unrelated files are preserved; validators pass; reviewer returns PASS with no findings.
